description: Match bank transactions against vouchers by amount and date proximity, in both directions: payments with no plausible voucher (missing receipts) and non-draft vouchers no payment covers. Matching is a heuristic — treat the result as a checklist, not a verdict. Read-only.

dayWindow.description: Maximum days between payment and voucher date to still count as a match (default 5).

from.description: Start of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

to.description: End of period, dd.mm.yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd.

name: sevdesk_reconcile_transactions
title: Reconcile bank transactions with vouchers
